results.name: Chile
results.key_finding: Kast government froze regularisation for 182,000 already-registered migrants, targets roughly 336,000 for expulsion, and submitted an eight-amendment package allowing a 240-day emergency without congressional approval. A purported 2026 UN finding proved to be dated 2023 and was excluded; the band-crossing evidence test FAILED with no tier-4 source located.

results.name: McKesson
results.key_finding: GATE WARNING RESOLVED: the 284 million figure is an attacker claim counting database ROWS, not patients, and McKesson confirmed no count. The SEC Form 8-K (tier 5) shows public disclosure on 2026-08-28, three days after discovery and three days EARLIER than the scan recorded.

results.name: Sudan
results.key_finding: Floor confirmation at 0.0 with ZERO downward room against a 5.0 trigger. The scan claim that RSF village attacks on 20 August killed six civilians is not present in the cited source and was dropped.

results.name: Haiti
results.key_finding: Kenscoff massacre re-fetched and still stands (47 killed, 50+ kidnapped, UN Integrated Office figures, two independent organisations). Gang conduct not scored against the state; state protective failure and state response scored. Same 3.1 as 2026-08-20 on entirely different evidence.

results.name: Nigeria
results.key_finding: FIGURE CORRECTION: the scan said 963 killed; both cited sources say 1,142. Kidnappings rose 66% to 7,825. Non-state conduct not scored against the state; Equity and Systemic Thinking fell on the 85% northern concentration and an uninterrupted ransom economy.

results.name: India
results.key_finding: ATTRIBUTION SPLIT: Manipur police tear gas and seven detentions are state action and are scored; the two Kangpokpi deaths were caused by suspected militants and are NOT scored against the state. The scanner used a single partisan source; corroborated against four Indian outlets before scoring.

results.name: Ethiopia
results.key_finding: SOURCING CORRECTION: the scan credited Amnesty International with describing ENDF drone strikes; the Amnesty article mentions no drone strikes and is dated 2026-08-03, 24 days before the scan evidence_date. ENDF strikes including on a school confirmed via Critical Threats. The real -2.8 deterioration is UNFILABLE: 4.7 points of room against a 5.0 trigger.

results.name: Democratic Republic of Congo
results.key_finding: The scan missed that the Ebola outbreak became the deadliest in DRC history (UN News, tier 4, 2,325 deaths; WHO: 'outpacing the response'). The M23 allegation of DRC drone strikes on Minembwe was unverified by Al Jazeera and is NOT scored. 2.3 points of room against a 5.0 trigger.

results.name: Cameroon
results.key_finding: An exact confirmation arrived at, not assumed: transparency rose one step on the ministry admitting its femicide figures are only 'the tip of the iceberg'; resource mobilisation fell one step on HRW-documented chronic underinvestment. Baseline verified as applied 2026-08-20, so no stale-baseline argument was available.

results.name: 3M
results.key_finding: The assessed +5.3 would be filable but is DELIBERATELY NOT FILED: 3M surfaced on negative evidence and the positive conduct (completed PFAS manufacturing exit) finished at end-2025, out of window. Lawsuit filing date corrected from 30 to 26 August. Published 20.3 is the known seed value and is routed for cohort calibration.

results.name: Starbucks
results.key_finding: The boycott was EXCLUDED as third-party conduct. Union-asserted unfair-labor-practice counts (550 vs 700+ vs 400+) contradict each other and were NOT relied on. The movement rests on the five-year unconcluded first contract, not on new in-window conduct.

results.name: Guinea-Bissau
results.key_finding: Published 13.1 verified as applied 2026-08-16; the pre-application 20.3 was not used anywhere. The referendum consolidating presidential power moved consent orientation and structural critique to the floor; an incident-free 55%-plus turnout is credited and holds Action and Empathy at 2.0.

results.name: Bangladesh
results.key_finding: SOURCE INDEPENDENCE FAILS: the scan's two sources are the same IANS wire republished. The report makes no state attribution. Held at the 2026-07-24 vector per the gate-warning instruction. Sits 0.2 points inside the filing threshold for a second consecutive assessment.

results.name: Kenya
results.key_finding: THIRD protest-policing incident in three consecutive cycles. The 2026-08-18 assessment pre-committed in writing to escalate on a third incident; it landed 2026-08-28. Correction willingness falls to anchor 1: IPOA has been investigating since June while protest policing continued. The triggering incident rests on one tier-2 source, disclosed in the proposal.

results.name: Israel
results.key_finding: Floor confirmation at 0.0 with ZERO downward room. The standing attribution practice was cited, not re-decided. All three sources re-fetched and unamended; HRW documents 107 communities and 5,900 Palestinians displaced and 6.6 settler attacks a day.

results.name: Nationwide
results.key_finding: NEVER-ASSESSED UNIFORM SEED at 60.9, shared identically with three other entities in this backfill. 38 of 40 subdimensions rest on absence of disclosure, not misconduct. NOT filed per anti-false-positive screening check 5; routed for a four-entity cohort de-seeding study.

results.name: Norfolk Southern
results.key_finding: The one backfill entity that is NOT a 60.9 seed. NTSB findings that the railroad withheld tank temperatures from the incident commander and used vent-and-burn without considering safer options; 622 million dollars in settlements credited. Evidence is 2023-2025 and is stated as such throughout.

results.name: Principal Financial
results.key_finding: NEVER-ASSESSED UNIFORM SEED. The strongest discloser of the four: a quantified emissions time series showing a 53.6% cut against a 2019 baseline. 37 of 40 subdimensions still rest on absence of disclosure. NOT filed; cohort study recommended.

results.name: Raymond James Financia
results.key_finding: NEVER-ASSESSED UNIFORM SEED. 39 of 40 subdimensions rest on absence of disclosure. SEPARATE RECORD DEFECT REPORTED: the index name appears truncated by one character ('Financia'). Not corrected, because renames are index writes requiring founder approval. NOT filed; cohort study recommended.

results.name: Regions Financial
results.key_finding: NEVER-ASSESSED UNIFORM SEED PLUS DOCUMENTED CONDUCT — the only one of the four filed. CFPB 191 million dollar consent order (tier 5) for charging overdraft fees after telling customers they had sufficient funds, a REPEAT of a 2015 order. Most of the -38.4 measures absence of assessment, not misconduct; the roughly 2-4 point gap below its seed peers is the conduct component.

floor_and_near_floor_findings.note: Five of twenty entities have less downward room than the 5.0 magnitude filing trigger, and all five are already in the lowest band so the band-crossing clause cannot fire either. Ethiopia is the sharpest case: this cycle produced a real, evidenced -2.8 deterioration on state-military drone strikes across Tigray, including a strike on a school, that the rules do not permit to be proposed. Sudan and Israel are fully evidence-insensitive at 0.0. Escalated as a methodology finding under the stop-and-report trigger for floor-insensitive entities; no movement was manufactured.
floor_and_near_floor_findings.remedy_recommended: A sub-floor severity annotation carried alongside the composite, so the record can distinguish an evidenced floor from a silent one and can register deterioration below 0.0. This is a methodology decision and is not encoded as any score change here.

seed_cluster_finding.precedent: Cerebras Systems 2026-08-16 (identical 60.9 seed, -22.1, zero adverse evidence in either direction); 20.3 seed cluster de-seeded 2026-08-20
seed_cluster_finding.handling: Three confirmed with no proposal, per anti-false-positive screening check 5 (a pure calibration concern must be routed for cohort review, not filed as a one-off baseline reset). Regions Financial filed as flag-for-review because it additionally carries a tier-5 CFPB consent order for a repeat violation, and confirming an Established band label against that record would leave a published band label the evidence contradicts.
seed_cluster_finding.recommended_remedy: Coordinator-level four-entity cohort de-seeding study, on the model of the 2026-08-20 20.3 seed-cluster study. A nightly assessor filing four separate three-band drops on absence of evidence is the wrong instrument.
seed_cluster_finding.absence_floor_observed: The three cluster peers with zero adverse evidence assess at 25.0, 25.6 and 26.9. That range is what absence of disclosure alone produces in this sector, and it is the reference point for separating calibration from conduct in Regions Financial.

date_and_attribution_corrections.detail: Scan recorded disclosure on 2026-08-31; the SEC Form 8-K was filed 2026-08-28, three days earlier. 31 August is the TechCrunch publication date. The speed of disclosure is precisely what was being scored.

284 million is an attacker claim counting database ROWS, not patients; the attacker disclaimed knowing the individual count and McKesson confirmed no figure. No patient count is used anywhere in the assessment.
BleepingComputer, marked date_verified:false by the scanner, resolves on re-fetch and is dated 2026-08-28.

Disclosure was made under Item 7.01 (voluntary Regulation FD), not Item 1.05 (material cybersecurity incident); the filing states the company has not determined the incident is material. Both facts scored, in opposite directions.
Scan said 963 killed; both cited sources say 1,142 (up from 762). Corrected and 1,142 used.

The SBM Intelligence report is cited under two different titles ('The Capture of Nigeria's Kidnap Economy' vs 'The Economics of Nigeria's Kidnap Industry, 2026') and two different release dates (27 vs 28 August) by the two secondaries. Recorded, unresolved; no scoring depends on it.

The scan credited Amnesty International with describing ENDF drone strikes. The Amnesty article contains no reference to drone strikes at all. The drone-strike evidence is Critical Threats (tier 2), not Amnesty. Attribution corrected.
The Amnesty source is dated 2026-08-03, 24 days before the scan evidence_date of 2026-08-27 and outside the scan window. Used as in-currency background only, not as within-window evidence.
Forced conscription and movement restrictions are attributed by Amnesty to TIGRAYAN authorities, a regional non-federal actor, and are NOT scored against the federal government.
Whether the ENDF strikes killed civilians is disputed between AFP and the BBC per Critical Threats. Not established, not scored in either direction.
The two Kangpokpi deaths were caused by suspected militants and are NOT scored as state action. Only the Kakching tear-gas dispersal and the seven detentions (four women) are scored as state conduct.
The protest was 'No NRC, No Census' (National Register of Citizens), not primarily delimitation as the scan framed it.

The scanner's sole source was Kashmir Media Service, a partisan outlet with a standing editorial position on India. Corroborated against Business Standard, Deccan Chronicle, India Today NE and Northeast News before anything was scored.
Scan dated the lawsuit 2026-08-30; it was filed 2026-08-26 in Dakota County District Court. 30 August is the Fox 9 publication date.
Both the Hastings suit and the Minnesota Pollution Control Agency suit are undecided allegations. Neither is scored as an established finding. Only 3M's documented response conduct is scored.

The scan claim that RSF village attacks on 20 August killed six civilians is not present in the cited Al Jazeera article, which carries no such dated attribution or figure. Dropped; does not appear in the assessment.
Attribution of the el-Obeid power transformer strike is not established in any located source and is NOT scored as state conduct. Only the failure to restore hospital electricity and water is scored.
RSF attacks are non-state conduct and not scored against the state; Sudanese Armed Forces conduct is scored as state conduct, consistent with the 2026-08-20 correction against the state.
The boycott, the AFL-CIO endorsement and the Chicago Teachers Union vote are third-party conduct — a campaign against the company — and are excluded from scoring entirely.

Union-asserted unfair-labor-practice counts (550 unresolved / more than 700 / more than 400 violations) are party-sourced, mutually contradictory by 150 or more, and unverifiable against a primary NLRB record. No subdimension rests on them.

The Kenscoff massacre is Viv Ansanm gang conduct and is NOT scored against the Haitian state. State protective failure (residents demanding the police chief resign despite proximity to the station) and state response (prompt public acknowledgment) are both scored.

The M23 spokesman's allegation of DRC forces conducting drone strikes on Minembwe on 22 August could not be verified by Al Jazeera and is NOT scored against the state. Attribution work was done in both directions: the government's roadmap participation is credited as positive state conduct.

The scan summary covered only the M23 peace talks and did not surface that the Ebola outbreak became the deadliest in DRC history inside the same window (UN News, tier 4, 17 August 2026). Incorporated in assessment.

retracted_or_stale_sources_found.detail: Search synthesis returned what appeared to be a 2026 UN Special Procedures communication to Chile ('Unauthorised border crossing cannot be considered a crime'), together with specific claims that migrant administrative detention had been extended from 5 days to 60 days renewable to 180, and that healthcare centres, schools and social security agencies would be required to hand personal data on undocumented migrants to immigration authorities. On direct re-fetch the underlying Global Detention Project pages are dated 2023-06-01 and 2023-12-12, and the UN communication they quote is dated 2023-05-24 — three years outside the window. The detention figures in the genuine 2023 document are different again (48 hours to 7 days, not 5 days to 60). The healthcare and school data-sharing claim appears in neither page. ALL OF IT WAS EXCLUDED and none of it scored. This is the same failure pattern as the confirmed 2026-07-24 defect: a prior-period statistic surfacing as current.
retracted_or_stale_sources_found.consequence: Chile's band-crossing evidence test failed as a direct result — with the 2023 material removed, no tier-4-or-above within-period source remains.

math_hygiene: NONE FOUND. The canonical computeCompositeFromDimensions reproduces every published composite in this cohort exactly, including all four 60.9 seed vectors, Chile's 62.5 and Sudan's and Israel's 0.0. No discrepancy exceeds 0.5 points anywhere.
scoring_convention: Absence of disclosure scores 2, never 1. A score of 1 requires positive documented evidence of a specific failure. Disclosure density is reported per entity in each assessment's Disclosure section.
